scope: Shell/Vivo Energy Morocco read-only public-source cross-check

evidence.observation: Official Shell directory identifies the site and coordinates but currently states 'No EV charging information available'.
Kia Maroc currently lists 'Shell Melloussa' among Morocco EV charging locations.
Third-party listing reports 2 charging points, CCS + Type 2, 50 kW maximum and free access, but leaves operator blank.

assessment.reason: The existence of EV charging at the Shell-branded site is supported by two non-CPO public sources, while Shell's own current station directory explicitly provides no EV charging information. CPO, access network, tariff channel and live status source remain unresolved.
assessment.production_rule: Do not promote this candidate as Shell Recharge or assign Vivo Energy as CPO without a native operator/app confirmation. Keep as diagnostic candidate only.
assessment.manual_verification_target: Check the physical site or any Shell/Vivo/EV roaming app for connector count, power, access method, tariff and operator attribution.
